name: OpenAI Admin — Projects
description: List projects in the OpenAI organization (governance audit input). Requires an admin API key (sk-admin-...).

steps.instruction: Sign in at platform.openai.com with an account that has the Owner role on the organization you want to audit.
Confirm you understand that an admin API key has org-wide visibility (all projects, members, audit logs).

capture.label: I understand this key grants org-wide visibility and will be stored encrypted in Hakuna's vault.

steps.instruction: Open Settings → Admin Keys → Create admin key. Scope: read-only is sufficient.
Copy the admin key (starts with sk-admin-).

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with OpenAI Admin API. Verify the key starts with sk-admin- and the calling user has Owner role.
